title: cenar, quemar, romper, se for 'gets', estos / esos

cards.title: la cena, cenar
cards.body: Cenar (to dine) isn't formal in Spanish; it just means 'to have dinner'.

cards.title: The dinner was burning = se quemaba
cards.body: 'La cena quemaba' sounds incomplete (burning what?). With nobody else involved, use se. Word order is flexible because the grammar carries the meaning.

examples.es: La cena se quemaba. / Se quemaba la cena.

cards.title: me quemo en el sol
cards.body: 'Quemo en el sol' would mean you burn something in the sun.

examples.en: I get burnt in the sun.

cards.title: romper = to break; todo el tiempo
cards.body: Think 'rupture'. Check the type (romper: -er) before adding se, so it's se rompe. Todo el tiempo = all the time.

cards.title: estos / esos
cards.body: Este has the e of el; estos has the -os of los. Drop the t for 'that / those'.

examples.en: Those ones break all the time.
examples.es: Esos se rompen todo el tiempo.

cards.title: Which verbs need se?
cards.body: Some verbs need se when nothing else is affected (se rompe, se transforma); others don't (cambia, from cambiar, 'it changes'). Listening builds the intuition.

practice.en: I get burnt in the sun.
Those ones break all the time.
es: Esos se rompen todo el tiempo
